export.heading: Research export
export.intro: CSV, XLSX and SQL extracts of the CAI research tables — one row per participant with the global pre-test and Final Test, per-chapter pre/post scores and attempts, Knowledge Mission results, and the satisfaction survey. Practical/rubric fields are kept and marked legacy. Teacher/Admin only — a learner is denied at the database, not just the page.
export.auditNote: Every export run writes one audit event (who, what, when): the download itself is the audited call, never the page view.
export.emptyCohort: Empty cohort: no learner rows yet — the downloads still work (header-only files) and every run is still audit-logged.
export.legacyNote: Worksheet submissions and rubric scoring are legacy (retired by ADR-0005). They are exported for cohort history only.
